title: Use PerfView to Collect Event Trace Data

facts.text: Download and install PerfView from Microsoft link to collect server event trace data.
Open PerfView, select Collect menu, set data file path with .etl extension, enable Advanced options.
Type Microsoft-DynamicsNAV-Server in Additional providers field to collect trace events.
Filter specific trace events using hexadecimal keyword values: service calls (0x4), AL functions (0x8).
Combine keyword values by addition: 0x4 and 0x8 yields 0xC for both event types.
Start Collection to begin recording and Stop Collection to end recording trace data.
View .etl file by double-clicking file, then Events to display traces, double-click trace for details.
